title: Device sort cards
subject: Computing
source: Seeded from computing/y9 lesson 5 (Device sort cards (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 5: Hardware and software; input, output and storage. To understand how hardware and software work together in a computer system

blocks.title: Sort into: Input / Output / Storage
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Input, Output, Storage.
blocks.answer: Input: Keyboard; Webcam; Microphone. Output: Monitor; Speaker; Printer. Storage: SSD; USB flash drive

questions.q: Is a touchscreen input, output or both? Explain.
questions.a: Both: it detects touches (input) and displays images (output).
questions.model: Teacher asks two questions of the device: does data go in? yes, touches. Does data come out? yes, the display. So both.

questions.q: Classify: spreadsheet program, antivirus, operating system.
Name the part of the system that processes data.
Core: For a smart doorbell, list its inputs, process, outputs and storage in the portal response box.
questions.a: Inputs: button, camera, microphone; process: chip decides to notify; outputs: chime, phone alert; storage: saved clips.
questions.model: Teacher completes the inputs row aloud.

questions.q: Extend: Explain why a computer needs both hardware and software, using an example.
questions.a: Hardware provides the physical means to compute; software gives the instructions. A laptop with no OS cannot run Teams.

questions.q: Stretch: A device driver is system software. Explain what it does.
questions.a: It lets the operating system communicate with a specific piece of hardware, such as a printer.

questions.q: A webcam is... A) an output device B) an input device C) storage
Big question: what do a smartphone, washing machine and car computer have in common?
questions.a: Hardware running software, with input, processing, output and storage.
